notes.title: Update 1.02! Up And Over DLC.
notes.content: Thank you everyone for supporting our launch :) we are happy to annouce the first free DLC content update Up And Over! This gamemode has you capture trenches from the germans and avoid enemy fire. Hope you guys have a great time in it. Remember to keep and eye out for the next DLC. Thanks again guys.
